basic_info.description: Perched perfectly on Ashbury Terrace in the exclusive neighborhood of Ashbury Heights! 37 Ashbury Terrace is a wonderful 4 Bedroom, 3.5 bath home with fantastic views and quintessential San Francisco charm. As you enter this elegant home, you'll quickly feel the warmth of this gracious open floorplan. An entertainer's dream home with hardwood floors and amazing details throughout. Up the grand staircase which leads to 3BD's & 2BA's and a glass enclosed sun room with breathtaking views. The primary bedroom offers great closet space & renovated bath en-suite. The second bath on this floor is renovated and serves the 2 bedrooms. The lower floor of the home offers a family room, additional bedroom and bath as well as mudroom with washer & dryer. 2 car garage and access to the lovely yard. Buy before Easter to enjoy the Ashbury Terrace Annual Neighborhood Easter Egg.
